en.name: Lixing Tan
en.headline: Exploring finance through theory and data.
en.intro: I am an Economics undergraduate at Dalian University of Technology, interested in financial engineering, finance, and data science. My work connects financial models with empirical analysis and machine learning.
en.aboutTitle:
A foundation in economics.
A curiosity for what comes next.
en.aboutText: My academic path combines economics coursework, an exchange year at Xiamen University, and research in quantitative finance. Through banking and insurance internships, I have also explored how analysis supports everyday business decisions. I am pursuing opportunities for further study and professional growth in finance and data.
en.researchTitle: Where financial theory meets empirical work.
en.paperTitle: Stock Index Option Pricing Based on the BS-XGBoost Hybrid Model: Evidence from CSI 300 and SSE 50 Index Options
en.paperSummary: A hybrid residual correction approach: Black–Scholes provides the baseline, and XGBoost learns the remaining pricing error. The study uses 2023–2024 CSMAR daily data and evaluates performance on CSI 300 and SSE 50 index options.
en.resultsNote: Results reported in the published paper; performance is specific to the study’s data and evaluation setup.

zh.name: 谭立星
zh.eyebrow: 经济学 · 金融 · 数据
zh.headline:
以金融理论为起点，
用数据探索问题。
zh.intro: 我是大连理工大学经济学专业本科生，关注金融工程、金融学与数据科学。希望将金融模型、实证分析与机器学习结合，理解市场中的实际问题。
zh.portraitCaption: 谭立星 / 经济学本科生
zh.aboutTitle:
立足经济学，
探索金融与数据的交汇。
zh.aboutText: 我的学习经历涵盖经济学课程、厦门大学交流学习以及量化金融研究。在银行与保险公司的实习中，我也逐渐了解数据分析如何服务于实际业务决策。目前，我希望在金融与数据相关方向继续深造，并探索职业发展机会。

zh.researchTitle: 让金融理论与实证分析相遇。
zh.paperTitle: 基于 BS 与 XGBoost 混合模型的股指期权定价研究——以沪深300及上证50为例
zh.paperSummary: 以 Black–Scholes 模型提供基准价格，再使用 XGBoost 学习定价残差。研究使用 CSMAR 数据库 2023—2024 年日度数据，在沪深300及上证50股指期权上开展实证分析。
